{{samename|volumes published in English by VIZ Media|List of Pokémon Sun & Moon volumes}}
The {{MangaArc|Sun, Moon, Ultra Sun & Ultra Moon}} of Pokémon Adventures is being separately collected into mini-volumes by [[Shogakukan]] in Japan. The volume releases began on June 23, 2017, and later ended on December 27, 2019. Once the {{MangaArc|Omega Ruby & Alpha Sapphire}} ends in the regular volumes, the ''Sun & Moon'' chapter will be properly collected in that format as well.
